personality_one_liner: A raw, high-contrast, industrial counting tool built for speed and precision.

spacing.rule: Rigid grids, hard alignment, visible structure. Cards fill horizontal space. 2pt borders define hierarchy.

dont's: No glassmorphism, no blur, no soft shadows. Brutalism relies on solid colors and hard borders.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure entry for the store owner using a PIN.
screens.layout: Massive 'StockTap' logo/text at top. A 4-digit PIN entry with oversized square boxes (2pt borders). A hard-edged numeric keypad taking up the lower half of the screen. Mono typography for digits.

screens.name: Inventory (Home)
screens.purpose: Glanceable product list where the stock count is the most prominent element.

states.loading: Skeleton of rows with hard outlines
states.empty: Illustration/Photo of an empty shelf, massive 'NO STOCK' text, and a primary CTA to 'ADD PRODUCT'
states.error: Readable mono text with a sharp retry button

screens.layout: Top: Search bar (rectangle, 2pt border, mono text). Below: Single-line horizontal scroller for category chips (sharp rectangles, selected state is inverted surfaceInverse). Below: Product list. Each row is a full-width rectangle with 2pt bottom border. Inside row: Left square product image (border-right), middle SKU (mono) & Name (Space Grotesk), right side has a massive stock number in Space Mono. If stock is low, the background of the number area flips to warning or brand primary. Tap row -> Opens Tap-to-Count Sheet.

screens.name: Tap-to-Count (Bottom Sheet)
screens.purpose: Rapid, ergonomic stock updating with massive tap targets and haptic feedback.
screens.layout: Bottom sheet takes up 75% height. Top: Product name and current stock (massive 3xl Space Mono text). Middle: Manual entry text input (large, hard borders). Bottom: Two massive split buttons (Left: '-', Right: '+') spanning the full width, easy to hit with thumbs. Haptic trigger on every press. Reset button small and far away at top right of the sheet.

screens.name: Add/Edit Product
screens.purpose: Form to add or edit inventory items.
screens.layout: Single column form. Mono labels above sharp rectangular inputs. Top section for adding product photo (camera/gallery). Sticky Submit button anchored at bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView. All borders 2pt.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a Brutalist design: NO rounded corners (radius 0 everywhere), 2pt hard solid borders on inputs, buttons, and cards.
Use Space Grotesk for headings/names and Space Mono for ALL numeric data (counts, SKUs, prices) to create a mechanical, tabular feel.
Do NOT use glassmorphism, blur, or soft shadows. Stick to solid colors and color flips (surfaceInverse) for active states.
On the Home list, emphasize the stock count number above all else. Apply a stark background color behind the number if the stock is below a threshold (low stock warning).
Category chips must be a single-line horizontal scroller using sharp-edged rectangles.
Implement the 'Tap-to-Count' interaction as a Gorhom Bottom Sheet. It should feature massive '+' and '-' buttons at the bottom for thumb ergonomics.
HAPTICS ARE CRITICAL: You must trigger a light haptic impact on every '+' or '-' press in the counter.
Ensure the primary CTA on forms (like Add Product) is sticky at the bottom.
